speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twenty miles. You walked them. The back is no worse than it was at midday. Sit, and pay the nine pence before you start a speech about sitting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine pence. The back can have the bench. I am not going to thank it in a room full of gowns.

speaker: (the scholar)
text: She flees, and the verse says she stays to be admired. I have won the wager. The table may pay me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard him. I am not his tutor. Nine pence is enough argument for one supper, and the argument is with the house, not with Ovid.

speaker: (the scholar)
text: A laurel, then, if the table is shy of the line. I am not particular about the book, so long as I am right.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Let him be right at his own board. Our board is bacon and nine pence, and a man who walked twenty miles and has the sense not to spend them on a stranger's Latin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty miles. The back is no worse. I will say that, and I will not say his line for him, corrected or not.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then eat it while it is hot. Tomorrow is longer than this, and I will not have you correcting scholars in your sleep.
